newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt adds new oil blocks to bid round.
newsitem.headline: Egypt adds new oil blocks to bid round.

text.p: State-owned Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC) has extended the deadline for bids for two oil concession blocks and added seven other blocks, the EGPC official in charge said on Tuesday.

Sami Shahin, EGPC vice-president for concessions, told Reuters the new closing date for bids for the North Ras Qattara and the North Bahariya blocks was September 30, the same as that for six other blocks. The original deadline for the first two blocks was March 31.
"They have all been amalgamated and the closing date for the whole bid round will be September 30. Also we have added seven blocks, making a total of 15," he said.

The six blocks are West Mediterranean Deep Water A, West Mediterranean Deep Water B, Siwa, Assiut, North West Gemsa and North El Mesaha Trough. Details of the seven new ones will be available on Wednesday.
